_doc: Fixed, versioned shot set for look-and-fix (docs/visual-pipeline.md section 3), framed on the style slice. Bump version on any change; compare renders only within one version. scene is an engine path; pos/look_at in metres; settle_frames lets TAA, GI and exposure converge before capture; seed seeds the RNG per shot, then time is frozen for the capture. Iterations render to docs/shots/_work/ (git-ignored); only final/ and changes/ are committed.

shots.name: shot-01-wide
shots.judge: composition, depth layers, key light direction, fog, grade vs mood ref

shots.name: shot-02-hero-character
shots.judge: scale next to the 1.8 m reference, silhouette, materials, rim separation

shots.name: shot-03-small-prop
shots.judge: texel density, roughness response, edge wear, cohesion with neighbours

shots.name: shot-04-building
shots.judge: modular seams, trim sheet scale, decals, door vs reference height

shots.name: shot-05-ground-low
shots.judge: ground blend, secondary detail, contact shadows, no seams

shots.name: shot-06-backlit
shots.judge: into the key light: rim and translucency, haze, bloom threshold, no black shadows

shots.name: shot-07-distance
shots.judge: tiling at distance, aerial perspective, silhouettes against sky

shots.name: shot-08-ui-over-play
shots.judge: UI palette and type vs ref, legibility over the busiest background
